---
title: Model and learning-rate study
config:
  runs: runs/fit/**
  baseline: runs/fit/linear-lr0.03/seed0
  repeated: runs/fit/cubic-lr0.3
---

Each run fits `datasets/points` with one model, learning rate and seed, for
example `python train.py -m model=linear,cubic learning_rate=0.03,0.3`. The report
compares the latest version of every run matching `{python} cfg.runs`; build it
for a subset with `cairn report build report.qmd 'runs=runs/fit/cubic*/*'`.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import statistics
from itertools import groupby

import cairn
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import Markdown, display


def configuration(run):
    return run.config["model"]["name"], run.config["learning_rate"]


def summary(runs):
    losses = [run.value["loss"] for run in runs]
    spread = statistics.stdev(losses) if len(losses) > 1 else 0.0
    return len(losses), statistics.mean(losses), spread


runs = sorted(cairn.find(cfg.runs), key=configuration)
assert runs, f"No runs match {cfg.runs}; train some first (see README.md)"
groups = {key: summary(list(group)) for key, group in groupby(runs, key=configuration)}
favourite = min(groups, key=lambda key: groups[key][1])
best = cairn.find(cfg.runs, order="/value/loss", limit=1)[0]
baseline = cairn.use(cfg.baseline)
```

## Results {#sec-results}

```{python}
#| label: tbl-loss
#| tbl-cap: Final training loss per configuration, over its seeds.
#| echo: false
rows = "\n".join(
    f"| {model} | {rate} | {count} | {mean:.4f} ± {spread:.4f} |"
    for (model, rate), (count, mean, spread) in groups.items()
)
display(Markdown("| Model | Learning rate | Seeds | Loss |\n| - | - | - | - |\n" + rows))
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-loss
#| fig-cap: Training loss per step of every run.
#| echo: false
figure, axis = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.3))
for run in runs:
    records = list(run.records(fields=["/step", "/loss"]))
    axis.plot([r["/step"] for r in records], [r["/loss"] for r in records], label=run.name)
axis.set(xlabel="Step", ylabel="Loss", yscale="log")
axis.legend(fontsize="small")
figure.tight_layout()
display(figure)
plt.close(figure)
```

On average the `{python} favourite[0]` model with learning rate
`{python} favourite[1]` fits best (@tbl-loss, @fig-loss). The best single run is
`{python} best.name`, with a loss of `{python} f"{best.value['loss']:.4f}"`,
`{python} f"{1 - best.value['loss'] / baseline.value['loss']:.0%}"` below the
baseline `{python} str(baseline)`, finished on
`{python} f"{baseline.finished_at:%Y-%m-%d}"`.

## Repeated runs {#sec-repeated}

Training `{python} cfg.repeated` with other seeds, for example
`python train.py -m model=cubic learning_rate=0.3 seed=1,2,3,4`, publishes one run
per seed. `{python} cfg.repeated + "/*"` finds the latest version of each.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-repeated
#| tbl-cap: Final loss of every seed of the repeated configuration.
#| echo: false
repeats = sorted(cairn.find(cfg.repeated + "/*"), key=lambda run: run.config["seed"])
rows = "\n".join(
    f"| {run.config['seed']} | v{run.version} | {run.value['loss']:.4f} |" for run in repeats
)
display(Markdown("| Seed | Version | Loss |\n| - | - | - |\n" + rows))
count, mean, spread = summary(repeats)
luckiest = cairn.find(cfg.repeated + "/*", order="/value/loss", limit=1)[0]
```

Over `{python} count` seeds the loss is `{python} f"{mean:.4f} ± {spread:.4f}"`
(mean ± standard deviation), and seed `{python} luckiest.config["seed"]` gave the
lowest, `{python} f"{luckiest.value['loss']:.4f}"` (@tbl-repeated).
